device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC compact satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi
device.board: 73010A00 (bootloader version "3510DB 1.1.1", 128 MB DDR3 single-CPU C3503D platform)
device.soc: ALi M3510D / C3503D (chip word 0x3503D000, SDK chip code 0x10051, bootloader "chip_id: HW_TYPE_CHIP+83; product_id 0.")

panel.chip: CH455 (TM1650-compatible, driven by bootloader on external IR/LED sensor pins)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (3510DB 1.1.1), maincode(AV) 0x060000 (73010A001235, LZMA 0x360D90 -> 12.6 MB), default_lang 0x52FD00 (1.0.0), countryband 0x52FF80 (1.0.0), img_webserver 0x537F80 (1.0.0), html_webserver 0x597F80 (1.0.0), logo_user 0x637F80 (1.0.0), logo_menu 0x647F80 (1.0.0), logo_radio 0x667F80 (1.0.0), logo_boot 0x687F80 (1.0.0), patch 0x6AFF80 (1.0.0), defaultdb(PRC) 0x6D0000 (1.0.1), userdb(64+64) 0x73FF80 (1.0.1, 0xC0070 bytes)

source.author: Dekolte / Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Mira2_wifi_1.2.35_emu 14.04.2021.zip from the Amiko/Amiko HD folder on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503D000, run_dump_mira2_wifi_app_starts.py, run_dump_mira2_wifi_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM SRAM bootloader ("3510DB 1.1.1") copies itself to 0x81000000, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel bus on GPIO 24 (SCL) / 23 (SDA), verifies the CRC of maincode(AV), unpacks 12.6 MB (0xC9840C bytes) to 0x80000200 and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000, where libc_printf at 0x802F7C04 is a stubbed no-op).  The application attaches its CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 24 / 23 (updating it to " on "), unpacks defaultdb(PRC) into userdb(64+64), and draws its 4-colour 1280x720 CLUT8 OSD dialog through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands).

desc: Amiko Mira2 WiFi EMU firmware v1.2.35 (System ID 73010A00, dated 2021-04-14) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver with built-in Wi-Fi on the single-CPU ALi M3510D / C3503D SoC (128 MB DDR3, 8 MB SPI flash).
Amiko sibling of the Edision Picco S2 (System ID 73010100), sharing the 3510DB 1.1.1 bootloader on GPIO 24 / 23 while compiling out maincode UART printf.
